_comment: WHAT IS PLUGGED IN. Selects units from shared/inventory.json and gives each
one an address, a position and a set of tags. It does not describe the
hardware (that is the .qxf), the room (venue.json), or what was measured on
Looks reference TAGS, never fixture ids or names. That is what lets a look
built for these four heads run on a club rig with eight.
Addresses match events/despacio/patch_sheet.csv as the show ran. 'position'
is in millimetres, y up, origin at the room's front-left floor corner --
the same frame venue.json uses. A fixture with a position becomes a
'hold' pins a channel every single frame. Reset is held at 0 because this
fixture treats 250-255 as a hold-to-reset command, and a stuck LTP value
there once put every head into a permanent reset loop.
name: despacio

fixtures.name: Pinspot #1
fixtures.notes: Channel 0 is a mode selector, not a dimmer. Confirmed on hardware 2026-08-01: the usable band is 240-255 (RGBW On); the .qxf's 9-134 White Dimmer band does not behave as a dimmer. Holding it at 255 every frame means the fixture is always in RGBW mode and brightness comes entirely from the R/G/B/W channels, which do behave linearly. Held by channel NAME because no generic role fits a mode selector.
